title: Self-organized criticality
relevance: Foundational paper introducing the concept of self-organized criticality and the BTW sandpile model. Establishes that extended dissipative dynamical systems can naturally evolve to a critical state with power-law-distributed avalanches, providing the theoretical framework for interpreting Collatz delay distributions.

title: How Nature Works: The Science of Self-Organized Criticality
relevance: Comprehensive monograph expanding SOC theory to earthquakes, evolution, brain dynamics, and other natural phenomena. Provides the broad analogical framework for recognizing SOC-like signatures in arithmetic systems such as the Collatz map.

title: Power laws, Pareto distributions and Zipf's law
relevance: Authoritative review of power-law distributions across disciplines with rigorous statistical methods for detection and fitting. Directly applicable to testing whether Collatz delay distributions follow genuine power laws versus alternative heavy-tailed models.
